in_sanskrit.name: गोवर्णन्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who removes all the miseries and sorrows of the devotees, and bestows joy and happiness upon them. A name of Lord Krishna.

in_hindi.name: गोवर्णन्
in_hindi.long_meaning: The one who removes disputes and quarrels. A name of Lord Krishna.

in_tamil.name: கோவர்ண
in_tamil.long_meaning: The one who removes all troubles and miseries. A name of Lord Krishna.

in_telugu.name: గోవర్ణ
in_telugu.long_meaning: The one who removes all sorrows and bestows happiness upon the devotees. A name of Lord Krishna.

in_marathi.name: Gouranga
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Gau (Cows)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gouranga हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gouranga is a name derived from the Sanskrit language, which means 'Lord of the Gau (Cows)'. This name is associated with the Hindu deity Vishnu, who is often depicted as having cows or holding a conch, which symbolizes the sound of the universe's creation.
